items.text: I'll generate this thumbnail, paying close attention to the spacecraft accuracy and Japanese text fidelity.

Thumbnail created at 1280×672.

Key points checked:
- Akatsuki placed lower-left, Venus crescent upper-right.
- Main-engine/bottom face away from Venus, four corner attitude thrusters firing faint blue-white.
- No high-gain antenna disc on the engine face.
- Text rendered exactly in Japanese, thick white Gothic with black outline; 「静かな執念」 highlighted in yellow.
- Layout keeps titles in dark upper-left space, clear of Venus and the spacecraft.

If you want any tweaks—spacecraft angle, thruster brightness, title size/placement, or Venus crescent size—let me know.
